ns2:course.label: Individual Topics
ns2:course.description: Individual topics in research and/or reading for graduate students, to be conducted under the supervision of faculty members in cell and structural biology; designed to allow students to become more familiar with specialized fields of study prior to committing themselves to a specific area for their graduate degree. Approved for S/U grading only. May be repeated. Prerequisite: Consent of instructor.
